source_title: MEDKids Rib Cage starter card (demonstration data, unreviewed)
primary_objective: How ribs protect the heart and lungs
educational_content: The rib cage is made of bones called ribs. Most people have 12 pairs of ribs. The rib cage protects the heart and lungs. The ribs join the breastbone in the front and the spine in the back. The rib cage moves up and out when we breathe in.
learning_objectives: The rib cage is made of ribs.
The rib cage protects the heart and lungs.
The rib cage moves when we breathe.

forbidden_claims.claim: Boys have fewer ribs than girls
The ribs are made of muscle
